preambleOwnership.extendedBy: SLSI-P1-2 (via non-mutating in-sentinel wrapping of parse_args and stage_p1_1_binaries)

digestOnlyInvariant.description: Every platform image in scripts/foundation-images.txt (22 entries) and scripts/kagent-images.txt (8 entries) is resolved to an immutable sha256: manifest digest via registry inspection before export, and verified against on-disk OCI layout blobs. Zero floating tags (:latest) or floating semver (semver: '*') are permitted anywhere in bundle metadata or vendored manifests.

signingPosture.privateKeyStorage: OpenBao Transit KMS engine at transit/keys/slsi-release; never written to disk or repository history
signingPosture.claim: bundle-build attestation only; confers zero upstream SLSA provenance

offlineInvocationFlags.airgapExecution: Zero external network egress during verification. Operates inside network namespaces (unshare -n) or air-gapped hosts without connectivity.

expectedNonZeroAbortOnAttemptedEgress.policy: Offline verification strictly queries local on-disk OCI layout blobs and local public key. Any attempt to reach external networks, missing blobs, corrupted digests, or tampered signatures causes immediate non-zero abort.

exitCodes.1: MISMATCH (digest mismatch, tampered signature, floating tag in manifest, or private key leak)
exitCodes.3: COULD-NOT-VERIFY (missing blob, missing signature, truncated index, missing public key, or capacity gate abort)

substitutions: matchOIDCIdentity -> secretRef: { name: cosign-pub } in flux-operator.yaml
